Maya: Quick heads up 3042423d30: Ive got a mid-quarter relocation and also had a small RSU vest on 2026-04-05. I moved from NY to DE on 2026-03-20. My net payout shows full NY state withholding + federal. Is treaty or social security split handled automatically? Need wording for my accountant.
Diego (People Ops): Thanks for flagging. Did you complete the international tax questionnaire and update residency end in the HR portal?
Maya: Yes filled the questionnaire on 2026-03-22 and set residency end = 2026-03-20. I also submitted the INTL relocation packet.
Elena (Payroll): Pulling the equity payout run. Equity service shows tax withholding country = US / NY for the 2026-04-05 event, likely because our equity platform uses payroll residency snapshot from the prior payroll cycle.
Sofia (Tax): Two quick things: 1) Germany has tax credit/treaty aspects for RSU income but it's usually reported in Germany once resident; 2) Social security (Sozialversicherung) depends on whether you were subject to US social security during vesting period and if A1 certificate applies. We'll need dates of physical presence and whether you remained on US social security.
Maya: I left US social security on 2026-03-21 per HR benefits change. Employer stopped US SS deductions after 03/21.
Elena (Payroll): Noted. Because the equity vest occurred after the residency change, payroll ops will need to: a) reverse NY state withholding on the equity payout (if incorrectly applied), b) coordinate with equity provider for tax withholding code change, c) prepare explanatory payroll statement for accountant.
Diego (People Ops): Also looping in Tax Ops to confirm treaty applicability. Sofia, can we confirm whether RSU income should be reported to DE only and whether a US tax credit/FBAR angle exists?
Sofia (Tax): Will check. Short answer: if you were tax resident in Germany on 2026-04-05, Germany will tax worldwide income. US may have limited taxing rights for source income but treaty typically prevents double taxation via credits. Well request a tax memorandum. Might need to file an amended US return depending on withholding.
Maya: Will the payroll correction show as a separate refund line? I need documentation for my German tax preparer.
Elena (Payroll): Yes  we will issue a supplemental adjustment/refund line in the next payroll cycle and attach a payroll letter with tax type, gross, withheld federal and state amounts, and the reason code (residency snapshot mismatch). Also we'll flag potential W-2 changes and coordinate W-2/W-2C later.
TaxOps-bot: Ticket TAX-2026-091 created by Sofia (Tax)  priority: high  tags: equity, international, treaty.
Maya: Thank you. Please include dates of residency and a clear line showing payroll sovereignty (which period was NY vs DE). My accountant needs the timeline and amounts.
Sofia (Tax): We'll draft a short memo with timeline + treaty note and cc payroll for amounts. ETA: 3 business days.
Elena (Payroll): Creating payroll ticket PAY-2026-991 for the withholding reversal and statement. Status: in progress. ETA for payroll adjustment: next pay cycle 2026-04-15.
Diego (People Ops): I'll follow up with benefits to confirm social security stop date is recorded. Maya, well loop you into both tickets. :mag_right:
